title: Running total of deposits
prompt: Return each deposit_date, amount, and a running_total column that is the cumulative sum of amount ordered by deposit_date.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE deposits (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, deposit_date TEXT, amount REAL); INSERT INTO deposits VALUES (1,'2023-01-01',100.0),(2,'2023-01-02',50.0),(3,'2023-01-03',75.0),(4,'2023-01-04',25.0);
reference_sql: SELECT deposit_date, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY deposit_date) AS running_total FROM deposits;
